headline: US-Israel weigh renewed strikes on Iran (confirmation layer)
dek: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth made an unannounced visit to Israel Oct 19, met Netanyahu at Ovda Air Base (southern Israel, US refuelling aircraft + fighters deployed; UAE officials also present per Turkiye Today/Channel 13), amid US-Israel discussions on resuming major combat operations against…
sources: Axios (first report, 2 sources familiar); confirmed by senior US military official to CBS News; second Israeli source confirmed Tuesday

sections.what_happened: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth made an unannounced visit to Israel Oct 19, met Netanyahu at Ovda Air Base (southern Israel, US refuelling aircraft + fighters deployed; UAE officials also present per Turkiye Today/Channel 13), amid US-Israel discussions on resuming major combat operations against Iran. Visit came 8 days before Israel's Oct 27 parliamentary elections and a day after Trump's Truth Social 'Complete and Total Endorsement' of Netanyahu, in which Trump warned the US would 'soon finish the job' unless Iran changes course.
sections.what_verified: CBS News: senior US military official confirmed visit; second source in Israel confirmed meeting Tuesday; Hegseth's own X post placed him in CENTCOM AOR ('historic mission'); Channel 13: 'a number of issues were discussed, including Iran'; TRTW corroboration of Axios details.
sections.what_disputed: Pentagon and Israeli Embassy declined comment; Netanyahu's office did not respond — no official confirmation of agenda; no decision on renewed strikes announced. Election timing suggests optics motivation.
sections.why_matters: From the truth side: Washington and Tel Aviv quietly plan the next round against Iran days before an election, while Iran (Tasnim) says it is ready for a prolonged conflict. Label attributed vs confirmed honestly; Trump's 'finish the job' quote on screen with source.
sections.context: Background: Hegseth-Netanyahu secret Ovda meeting — US-Israel weigh renewed strikes on Iran (confirmation layer)
